possible_risks.description: Data provenance refers to the traceability of data (including synthetic data), which includes its ownership, origin, transformations, and generation. Proving that the data is the same as the original source with correct usage terms is difficult without standardized methods for verifying data sources or generation.
possible_risks.justification: Card mentions fine-tuning on a reflection dataset with thanks to Glaive AI and experimental KTO on argilla/distilabel-intel-orca-kto, but gives no details on collection, ownership, or generation of these datasets.

possible_risks.description: Proper documentation contains information about how a model's data was collected, curated, and used to train a model, including any synthetic data generation processes. Without proper documentation it might be harder to satisfactorily explain the behavior of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card states training data sources only by name/thanks and does not document how the reflection or KTO datasets were collected, curated, or generated.

possible_risks.description: Lack of model transparency is due to insufficient documentation of the model design, development, and evaluation process and the absence of insights into the inner workings of the model.
possible_risks.justification: Card provides no evaluation results, no training details beyond SFT+KTO, and no insight into model behavior or limitations.

possible_risks.description: Since foundation models can be used for many purposes, a model's intended use is important for defining the relevant risks of that model. As the use changes, the relevant risks might correspondingly change.
possible_risks.justification: Card does not define intended use or out-of-scope uses, only modalities and license.

training_context.adaptations: The model was fine-tuned using SFT (supervised fine-tuning) followed by KTO (Kahneman-Tversky Optimization), a method described as making alignment easier and cheaper without compromising performance.
training_context.training_data: The model was fine-tuned on a reflection dataset, with thanks to Glaive AI, and also underwent experimental KTO fine-tuning using the argilla/distilabel-intel-orca-kto dataset.
